tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page ground. Light is the guideline's cream #F6F1E9; dark is a deeper earth below French Puce so brown bands and cards still lift off it.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, word cards, press cards, notices.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells behind media (reel frame, audio scrubber track), alternating section bands.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and card borders only. Too faint for control borders: those use ink.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All running text and headings, on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken (12:1 and up in both themes). Also the secondary button border.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, metadata, IPA, glosses, on any surface (5.9:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: orange
tokens.usage: Brand Orange from the guideline. Fills only: primary buttons, the stat rule, active timeline dots, large display headings 24px+ on the dark theme or brown bands. Never small text on cream (2.2:1).

tokens.name: orange-text
tokens.usage: Orange as readable text: eyebrows, links, inline emphasis, on surface and surface-raised (5.7:1 light, 6.4:1 dark).

tokens.name: orange-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fills behind orange-text: 'In progress' badge, selected word card, the ask notice.

tokens.name: on-orange
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an orange or yellow fill (5.5:1 on orange, 9.9:1 on yellow). Never white on orange.

tokens.name: yellow
tokens.usage: Gargoyle Gas from the guideline. The top of the gold gradient, highlight fills, the focus ring in dark mode. Text only on brown.

tokens.name: brown
tokens.usage: French Puce from the guideline, fixed in both themes. The signature dark band (hero, quotes, footer) whatever the theme.

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Fixed cream: text on brown bands (12:1), whatever the theme.

tokens.name: gold-light
tokens.usage: Logo gradient top stop. Logo artwork only.

tokens.name: gold-deep
tokens.usage: Logo gradient bottom stop. Logo artwork only.

tokens.name: gold-shadow
tokens.usage: The logo's extruded edge. Logo artwork only.

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Status 'Done' text, on teal-soft. Teal rather than green so Done and Blocked never rely on red and green alone.

tokens.name: teal-soft
tokens.usage: Behind teal text in the Done badge.

tokens.name: rust
tokens.usage: Status 'Blocked' text and blocker timeline dots, on rust-soft or the surfaces.

tokens.name: rust-soft
tokens.usage: Behind rust text in the Blocked badge.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links. Alias of orange-text, underlined.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Space Mono Bold, as the guideline sets it. Headings are UPPERCASE; tracking tightens as size grows.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The one hero headline per page. 40px below 600px wide.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows, badges, button labels. Always uppercase.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Darker Grotesque runs small and light: set it larger than usual and never below weight 500 on screen.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: We recorded words, phrases and numerals with native speakers in Naikkhangchori.
styles.usage: All running text. Max 65 characters per line.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Photo credits, metadata, glosses. The smallest body size.

styles.name: word
styles.usage: A Chak headword (romanised) on a WordCard.

spacing.note: 4px base. Sections breathe; cards stay compact.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside badges, between stacked meta lines.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between a title and its body.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Minimum page gutter; button padding block.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; gaps in card grids.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between a section header and its content.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Desktop page gutter; between groups in a section.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of a page section (64px on phones).

radius.note: Shaped like the logo's clay pot: a narrow neck and a round belly. Containers take small top corners (radius-neck) and large bottom corners (radius-belly), so every card sits like a pot. Nothing is sharp-cornered except full-bleed bands.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, small tiles.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Plain boxes that are not pots: the audio scrubber, code.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The cover blocks.

tokens.name: radius-neck
tokens.usage: Top corners of every pot-shaped container: cards, notices, media frames.

tokens.name: radius-belly
tokens.usage: Bottom corners of pot-shaped cards and notices.

tokens.name: radius-belly-lg
tokens.usage: Bottom corners of large pot shapes: hero media, photo frames, the reel frame.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, badges, the audio play button: the logo's round stroke ends.

shadow.note: Warm, low shadows. Flat surfaces are the default; shadows mark only what floats or is pressed.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Cards at rest that sit on a band of the same colour.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: The hero logo plate, the playing word card.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every control: a 2px ground gap, then 2px solid brown (light) or yellow (dark).

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Maximum width of running text.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of section content.
